text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ngh. My nose is so itchy.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Mm… Well, King put some cream on my pimple.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: But it feels sticky and its smell is making my nose all itchy… Eugh.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I just want that pimple to go awaaay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara seems very worried about her skin problems.
